sources.content: The banterol image runs Banterol, a server that stores build artifacts for CI pipelines. It is built on alpine:3.20 and runs as user banterol with user ID 2000. The HTTP API listens on port 8350. Artifacts are stored under /srv/banterol/artifacts, and the metadata database lives in /srv/banterol/meta; mount volumes at both paths. The entrypoint is /usr/bin/tini, which starts /usr/bin/banterol with the serve command. Mount the volumes before first start, because Banterol creates its database schema on first run.

BANTEROL_MAX_UPLOAD sets the largest artifact a client may upload and defaults to 5GB. BANTEROL_RETENTION_DAYS sets how long artifacts are kept and defaults to 90. BANTEROL_AUTH_MODE accepts token or none and defaults to token. BANTEROL_LOG_FORMAT accepts json or text and defaults to json. The health check requests /api/ping every 30 seconds with a 5 second timeout and marks the container unhealthy after three failures. BANTEROL_PORT is not supported; change the published port instead.
